author: ShadyDingo
body:
I had a similar question and got this awesome response

 There's quite a few adorn options, though I don't really use them all

5 Selene legs: Straight forward 50% follower stat boost. Not much to mention, it's just good for pvp/raiding

5 Themis feet: Increased defence/resistance when using defend/bastion. Very good for anguish

5 Prom feet: Automatic ward regen can be nice

5 Prom hands: Crits, crits, crits. Mostly beoH, but can be used by base/auriga to some extent

5 Selene hands: A lot of attack and magic. Mostly beoH.

Mixed Selene + Prom hands: Crits and attack/magic. Mostly beoH, when you need a mix of higher penetration and damage.

Mixed Selene hands + hearts or Prom hands + Selene hearts: Attack/magic or crit combined with smart ai for a more reliable supportive follower. Mostly beoH specific.
